---
title: "SIR_test without parallel"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(deSolve)

set.seed(123)

# =========================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# =========================================================
times <- seq(0, 60, by = 1)

tau_true   <- 20
beta1_true <- 0.4
beta2_true <- 0.15
gamma_true <- 0.1
sigma_true <- 0.01

candidate_tau <- seq(5, 50, by = 1)

state_init <- c(S = 0.999, I = 0.001, R = 0)

nsim <- 2  # Need to increase 

# =========================================================
# 2. SIR MODEL
# =========================================================
sir_cp <- function(t, state, par) {
  
  S <- state[1]; I <- state[2]; R <- state[3]
  
  beta <- if (t <= par["tau"]) par["beta1"] else par["beta2"]
  
  N <- S + I + R
  
  dS <- -beta * S * I / N
  dI <- beta * S * I / N - par["gamma"] * I
  dR <- par["gamma"] * I
  
  list(c(dS, dI, dR))
}

# =========================================================
# 3. SAFE SOLVER
# =========================================================
safe_solve <- function(par) {
  
  out <- try(
    ode(
      y = state_init,
      times = times,
      func = sir_cp,
      parms = par,
      method = "ode45",
      rtol = 1e-3,
      atol = 1e-4,
      maxsteps = 5000
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  
  out <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(out$I))) return(NULL)
  
  out$I <- pmax(pmin(out$I, 1), 0)
  
  out
}

# =========================================================
# 4. LIKELIHOOD
# =========================================================
nll <- function(p, tau_fixed, y_obs) {
  
  par <- c(beta1=p[1], beta2=p[2], gamma=p[3], tau=tau_fixed)
  
  sim <- safe_solve(par)
  if (is.null(sim)) return(1e12)
  
  mu <- sim$I
  sigma <- max(p[4], 1e-4)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(mu))) return(1e12)
  
  -sum(dnorm(y_obs, mu, sigma, log=TRUE))
}

# =========================================================
# 5. SIMULATION STORAGE
# =========================================================
results <- data.frame(
  sim = 1:nsim,
  beta1_hat = NA,
  beta2_hat = NA,
  gamma_hat = NA,
  tau_hat = NA
)

# =========================================================
# 6. SIMULATION LOOP
# =========================================================
for (s in 1:nsim) {
  
  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Simulation", s, "of", nsim, "\n")
  cat("============================\n")
  
  true_par <- c(beta1=beta1_true,
                beta2=beta2_true,
                gamma=gamma_true,
                tau=tau_true)
  
  sim_true <- safe_solve(true_par)
  if (is.null(sim_true)) stop("True simulation failed")
  
  y_obs <- sim_true$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)
  
  cp_profile <- data.frame(tau=candidate_tau, nll=NA)
  fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
  
  start <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)
  
  for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
    
    tau_i <- candidate_tau[i]
    
    fit <- try(
      optim(
        par = start,
        fn = nll,
        tau_fixed = tau_i,
        y_obs = y_obs,
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
        upper = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
        control = list(maxit = 50)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error") && is.finite(fit$value)) {
      cp_profile$nll[i] <- fit$value
      fits[[i]] <- fit
    }
  }
  
  valid <- which(is.finite(cp_profile$nll))
  
  if (length(valid) == 0) {
    cat("All fits failed\n")
    next
  }
  
  best <- valid[which.min(cp_profile$nll[valid])]
  best_fit <- fits[[best]]
  
  tau_hat <- cp_profile$tau[best]
  
  par_hat <- best_fit$par
  names(par_hat) <- c("beta1","beta2","gamma","sigma")
  
  cat("Estimated tau:", tau_hat, "\n")
  
  results$beta1_hat[s] <- par_hat["beta1"]
  results$beta2_hat[s] <- par_hat["beta2"]
  results$gamma_hat[s] <- par_hat["gamma"]
  results$tau_hat[s]   <- tau_hat
  
  cat("Finished Simulation", s, "\n")
}

# =========================================================
# 7. CLEAN RESULTS
# =========================================================
res <- results[complete.cases(results), ]

print(res)

# =========================================================
# 8. SUMMARY TABLE
# =========================================================
if (nrow(res) > 0) {
  
  summary_table <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("beta1","beta2","gamma","tau"),
    True = c(beta1_true, beta2_true, gamma_true, tau_true),
    
    Mean = c(
      mean(res$beta1_hat),
      mean(res$beta2_hat),
      mean(res$gamma_hat),
      mean(res$tau_hat)
    ),
    
    Bias = c(
      mean(res$beta1_hat) - beta1_true,
      mean(res$beta2_hat) - beta2_true,
      mean(res$gamma_hat) - gamma_true,
      mean(res$tau_hat) - tau_true
    ),
    
    RMSE = c(
      sqrt(mean((res$beta1_hat - beta1_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((res$beta2_hat - beta2_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((res$gamma_hat - gamma_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((res$tau_hat - tau_true)^2))
    )
  )
  
  cat("\n================ FINAL SUMMARY ================\n")
  print(summary_table)
  
  cat("\nTau accuracy (±1):",
      mean(abs(res$tau_hat - tau_true) <= 1), "\n")
  
  hist(res$tau_hat,
       main = expression("Distribution of " * hat(tau)),
       xlab = expression(hat(tau)))
}

# =========================================================
# 9. PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP
# =========================================================

set.seed(999)

B <- 2 #Need to increase

boot_results <- data.frame(
  b = 1:B,
  tau_hat = NA,
  beta1_hat = NA,
  beta2_hat = NA,
  gamma_hat = NA
)

boot_par <- c(
  beta1 = mean(res$beta1_hat),
  beta2 = mean(res$beta2_hat),
  gamma = mean(res$gamma_hat),
  tau   = round(mean(res$tau_hat))
)

cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP START ================\n")
print(boot_par)

for (b in 1:B) {
  
  cat("Bootstrap", b, "of", B, "\n")
  
  sim_b <- safe_solve(boot_par)
  
  if (is.null(sim_b)) next
  
  y_boot <- sim_b$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)
  
  cp_profile <- data.frame(tau=candidate_tau, nll=NA)
  fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
  
  start <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)
  
  for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
    
    tau_i <- candidate_tau[i]
    
    fit <- try(
      optim(
        par = start,
        fn = nll,
        tau_fixed = tau_i,
        y_obs = y_boot,
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
        upper = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
        control = list(maxit = 40)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error") && is.finite(fit$value)) {
      cp_profile$nll[i] <- fit$value
      fits[[i]] <- fit
    }
  }
  
  valid <- which(is.finite(cp_profile$nll))
  
  if (length(valid) == 0) next
  
  best <- valid[which.min(cp_profile$nll[valid])]
  best_fit <- fits[[best]]
  
  tau_hat <- cp_profile$tau[best]
  
  par_hat <- best_fit$par
  names(par_hat) <- c("beta1","beta2","gamma","sigma")
  
  boot_results$tau_hat[b]   <- tau_hat
  boot_results$beta1_hat[b] <- par_hat["beta1"]
  boot_results$beta2_hat[b] <- par_hat["beta2"]
  boot_results$gamma_hat[b] <- par_hat["gamma"]
  
  cat("Estimated tau:", tau_hat, "\n")
}

cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP DONE ================\n")

boot_clean <- boot_results[complete.cases(boot_results), ]

print(boot_clean)

if (nrow(boot_clean) > 0) {
  
  cat("\nBootstrap tau accuracy (±1):",
      mean(abs(boot_clean$tau_hat - boot_par["tau"]) <= 1), "\n")
  
  hist(boot_clean$tau_hat,
       main = "Bootstrap distribution of tau",
       xlab = "tau")
}
```
